Proposition
[Hessian at a critical point is metric-independent]

Source: petersen:page-0066, petersen:page-0067 ↗ def:pet-ch2-hessian-lie-derivative

If $df|_p=0$, choose coordinates $x^i$ around $p$ with $g_{ij}|_p=\delta _{ij}$. Then $\operatorname {Hess}f|_p$ computed from $g$ equals $\operatorname {Hess}f|_p$ computed from the flat metric $\delta _{ij}dx^idx^j$ in the same coordinates.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-local-vanishing \sketch Since $df_p=0$, the vector field $ abla f$ vanishes at $p$. By subsection 1.2, $(L_{ abla f}g)_p$ depends only on $g_p$. In coordinates with $g_{ij}(p)=\delta _{ij}$ it therefore equals $L_{ abla f}(\delta _{ij}dx^i dx^j)|_p$, proving the claim after division by $2$.

□
